geom_reference_point: S_origin (geometric center of the 12U body envelope; CoM offset TBD per SSOT §4)

mount_face_M.note: Outer datum face of the robot_mount_adapter (flange) on the +X front task face = frame M origin. +Z_M := +X_S (mount-face normal / arm reach & target-approach direction), +X_M along task-face main bolt array (project +Z_S). Placed at Y=Z=0 to sit on the servicer CoM lateral projection (req 12U-LR-01) and near-coaxial with the camera. T_SM (S->M) is directly readable off this face after CAD: nominal translation [185.25,0,0] mm, rotation = +90deg about Y_S mapping X_S->Z_M.

robot_arm_workspace.note: forward capture/reach volume ahead of frame M; solar panels, antenna and nozzle are kept clear of it (baseline §2, req 12U-LR-02/05)

camera_fov_cone.note: must stay unoccluded by folded arm (req 12U-LR-04)

assumptions: S origin is placed at the geometric center of the 12U envelope; CoM is assumed near-center (Y=Z=0) but not yet computed — CoM offset and T_SB are TBD per SSOT §4.

Envelope taken as the nominal 12U (2x2x3) form: 340.5 mm (X) x 226.3 mm (Y) x 226.3 mm (Z). Exact CDS Appendix B dims are unverified (drawing-text parse failed, doc §1 limitation) and must be manually reviewed before CAD.

The 340.5 mm long axis is aligned with +X_S (rear service bay -> front task bay = target-approach). Three bays each 113.5 mm (1U) deep partition the body along X: rear [-170.25,-56.75], mid [-56.75,56.75], front [56.75,170.25]. Bay boxes share the full 226.3x226.3 cross-section and union into one monolithic body; internal bulkheads not modeled.

target_mass_kg = 24.0 kg adopted as the CDS Rev14.1 Table 1 12U max-mass reference, used as a design target for the display servicer (confidence low). Builder sizes effective density to hit it. Internal components (OBC/C&DH, EPS/PMAD, battery, reaction-wheel set, IMU) are lumped into the body mass, not modeled as separate outer geometry (they do not change the external envelope).

Robot mount face M = outer datum of a 140x140x15 mm adapter flange centered on the +X front face; M origin [185.25,0,0] mm, outward normal +X_S. Positioned at Y=Z=0 to lie on the CoM lateral projection (req 12U-LR-01) and clear of camera/panels/antenna (req 12U-LR-02).

Camera modeled as a Ø50 x 40 mm cylinder mounted on the front face, offset +80 mm in +Z above the arm mount, boresight +X and near-coaxial with the robot workspace (baseline §4 front-task-face C-over-B); it does not conflict with the mount or occlude when the arm is folded (req 12U-LR-04).

Solar panels modeled as two 227x200x6 mm flat plates deployed on ±Y with Z-normal, spanning only the rear+mid bays (X from -170.25 to +56.75) so they clear the forward robot workspace and camera FOV cone (baseline §2 side deployables). Deployed state assumed; stowed envelope TBD.

Propulsion placeholder = Ø90 x 60 mm cylinder on the -X rear face (nozzle, axis +X, protruding rearward). Antenna placeholder = Ø30 x 50 mm cylinder on the rear-bay +Z face. Both are isolated from the front-end robot workspace and the panels (baseline §2 rear service bay; req in reference-inputs §2).

No fillets, holes, rails, or -Z 'tuna-can' extra volume are modeled; rail contact zones and the -Z extra volume are intentionally left free per CDS. Block model = simple boxes + cylinders unioned only.
Grasp/marker points and tumble axis are N/A for the servicer (they belong to target/debris models); left empty/null.
Reference deployment system assumed rail-reference (baseline §3), pending Appendix B manual review.

Geometry only; inertia is self-defined downstream. No OreSat/PyCubed/BIRDS CAD is copied or renamed — external open assets informed only sub-system stacking/interface ideas per mapping doc §1 (whole-servicer geometry is original, risk RA-001).
